title: Aiding Radar Odometry with S-57 Nautical Charts for GNSS-free and Compass-free Pose Estimation
authors: C. Denker; C. Wölper; S. Stäudte; J. Wilbertz
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
